id.description: Unique identifier for the number input. The unit select takes `${id}-unit`.

value.description: The duration in milliseconds, or `null` when the field is empty. Bindable.

label.description: Visible label. Omit inside a FormField or SettingRow, which supplies the label.

description.description: Helper text announced with the field.

error.description: Validation error; marks the field invalid.

disabled.description: Disables the number and the unit.

name.description: Form field name for the number as typed (in the shown unit).

integer.description: Rounds the stored milliseconds to whole numbers, for a schema of type `integer`.

unit.description:
The unit the number is shown in, by its `value`. Starts as the largest unit that shows the
value as a whole number, and follows the person's choice. Bindable.

unitSelectable.description:
Whether the person can change the unit. When `false` the unit is fixed text inside the field's
frame ("30 seconds"), as a setting that always counts in seconds draws it.

commitWhileTyping.description:
Reports each duration as the number is typed, not only when the field is left or Enter is
pressed, for a field whose value writes through at once (a builder that shows its result as
you type). Text that is not a number yet (such as `-`) is not reported. Changing the unit
reports nothing: the stored value stays the same, and the number is shown in the new unit.

size.description:
Height step from the shared `--cinder-control-height-*` scale, for the number and the unit:
`sm` 28px, `md` 32px, `lg` 40px.

unsupportedProps.name: onblur
unsupportedProps.description: Called when the number loses focus.

unsupportedProps.name: onValueChange
unsupportedProps.description: Called with the next duration in milliseconds, or `null` when the number is cleared or unparseable.

unsupportedProps.name: units
unsupportedProps.description: The units on offer, smallest first. The default is milliseconds, seconds, minutes and hours.
